name: Nierius
backstory: Child of Niemus and Darius, in Salthos Cruzados; grew up around walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., and picked up a little of Forliamus Betrothal Offer along the way.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Toll Ledger Arrears their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Toll Ledger Arrears as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: picks up his father's watch along the Salthos stretch at dawn, waves familiar faces through without a second look, and is starting to spot the ones worth a second look

arc.premise: Nierius keeps his own private tally now of every toll receipt that crosses his post, set against what Gorff's ledger claims was paid, trying to nail down plainly whether the three-year shortfall is a clerk's slip or something Gorff's been getting away with.
